_doc: Data-driven abilities ported from pokemonAutoChess/app/core/abilities. Schema: docs/ABILITIES.md. Values are per star [1,2,3,(4)]. 'approx' marks simplified ports.

NUZZLE.name: Nuzzle
NUZZLE.desc: Dashes next to the farthest enemy, paralyses it 3s and deals 25/50/100 special damage.

HEAVY_SLAM.name: Heavy Slam
HEAVY_SLAM.desc: Slams the ground: 15/30/60 special damage to the adjacent enemies, more the more max HP it has than its target (x 1 + half the difference in % of the target's max HP).

PLAY_ROUGH.name: Play Rough
PLAY_ROUGH.desc: Charms the target 2.5s and deals 30/60/120 special damage.

STRING_SHOT.name: String Shot
STRING_SHOT.desc: Paralyses the target 5s and deals 10/20/50 special damage.

BLAST_BURN.name: Blast Burn
BLAST_BURN.desc: Explodes on the 8 cells around itself for 30/60/120 special damage.

SPIKY_SHIELD.name: Spiky Shield
SPIKY_SHIELD.desc: Deals 60/80/100% of DEF as special damage to the target and wears spiky armor for 3/5/10s.

MYSTICAL_FIRE.name: Mystical Fire
MYSTICAL_FIRE.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage and lowers the target AP by 15/20/25.

ROCK_SLIDE.name: Rock Slide
ROCK_SLIDE.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage to the target, doubled against FLYING.

GEAR_GRIND.name: Gear Grind
GEAR_GRIND.desc: Throws 2 gears at the target, each dealing 25/50/100% of SPEED as special damage.

RETALIATE.name: Retaliate
RETALIATE.desc: Hits the target for 150% ATK as special damage, one more time per fallen ally.

HEX.name: Hex
HEX.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage, doubled if the target has a negative status.

THUNDER_SHOCK.name: Thunder Shock
THUNDER_SHOCK.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage to the target.

SOAK.name: Soak
SOAK.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage and gives 10 PP to every ally.

TERRAIN_PULSE.name: Terrain Pulse
TERRAIN_PULSE.desc: Without a field, gets a Grassy field. The fields of its team spread to the adjacent allies without one, then each ally with a field: Grass heals 5/7/10% max HP, Electric +10/12/15 SPEED, Psychic +10/12/15 PP, Fairy 5/7/10% max HP as shield.

PECK.name: Peck
PECK.desc: Deals 10/30/50 special damage to the target.

FLOWER_TRICK.name: Flower Trick
FLOWER_TRICK.desc: Plants a flower on the target that explodes after 3s on the target and the 8 cells around it for 15/40/85 special damage.

HYDRO_PUMP.name: Hydro Pump
HYDRO_PUMP.desc: Fires a jet in a straight line through the target to the board edge, 20/40/80 special damage to every enemy on it.

ICICLE_CRASH.name: Icicle Crash
ICICLE_CRASH.desc: Drops icicles on the target and the 8 cells around it, 20/40/80 special damage.

BUG_BUZZ.name: Bug Buzz
BUG_BUZZ.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage, doubled on a paralysed target.

LEECH_LIFE.name: Leech Life
LEECH_LIFE.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage and heals itself by the damage dealt.

TICKLE.name: Tickle
TICKLE.desc: The 1/2/3 closest enemies lose 3 ATK and 3 DEF.

WHEEL_OF_FIRE.name: Wheel of Fire
WHEEL_OF_FIRE.desc: Rolls toward the farthest enemy: every enemy on the cells in between takes 10/20/40 special damage twice.

SHADOW_BALL.name: Shadow Ball
SHADOW_BALL.desc: Deals 30/60/100 special damage to the target; every enemy loses 2 SPE_DEF.

REFLECT.name: Reflect
REFLECT.desc: Reflects half of the physical damage it takes for 3s.

MAGIC_POWDER.name: Magic Powder
MAGIC_POWDER.desc: Gains 15/30/60 shield and silences the enemies on the 8 cells around it for 2/3/4s.

WHIRLPOOL.name: Whirlpool
WHIRLPOOL.desc: Sends a whirlpool toward the farthest enemy; the first enemy on its path takes 4 hits of 100% ATK as special damage.

SING.name: Sing
SING.desc: Puts the 1/2/3 front-most enemies to sleep for 2s.

LICK.name: Lick
LICK.desc: Confuses and paralyses the target 3s, and deals 30/60/120 special damage.

GUILLOTINE.name: Guillotine
GUILLOTINE.desc: Deals 300% ATK as special damage. Refunds half of its PP on kill.

MAGNET_BOMB.name: Magnet Bomb
MAGNET_BOMB.desc: 20/40/80 special damage to the target and 10/20/40 to the enemies around it; enemies 2 cells away are pulled next to it. Every enemy hit or pulled is locked 1.5s.

SALT_CURE.name: Salt Cure
SALT_CURE.desc: Allies within 2 cells gain 10/20/40 shield and are cured; WATER, STEEL and GHOST enemies within 2 cells burn for 5s.

HORN_ATTACK.name: Horn Attack
HORN_ATTACK.desc: Deals 300/400/500% ATK as special damage and breaks the target armor for 8s.

WAVE_SPLASH.name: Wave Splash
WAVE_SPLASH.desc: Gains 20% of max HP as shield, then slams the target for 20% of its max HP as special damage.

AQUA_STEP.name: Aqua Step
AQUA_STEP.desc: Steps toward the target, then deals 25/50/100 special damage and gains 10/15/20 SPEED.

MANTIS_BLADES.name: Mantis Blades
MANTIS_BLADES.desc: Strikes 3 times for 10/20/40: one physical, one special and one true damage hit.

ICE_BALL.name: Ice Ball
ICE_BALL.desc: Gains 10 SPE_DEF, then deals 10/20/30 + 50/100/150% SPE_DEF as special damage.

LEAF_BLADE.name: Leaf Blade
LEAF_BLADE.desc: A guaranteed critical strike for 100/125/150% ATK as true damage.

TELEPORT.name: Teleport
TELEPORT.desc: Teleports to a safe cell. Its next attack deals 15/30/60 more special damage; it cannot cast until then.

MAGICAL_LEAF.name: Magical Leaf
MAGICAL_LEAF.desc: Throws leaves toward the farthest enemy: enemies on the cells in between take 10/20/40 special damage and lose armor for 3s.

DARK_HARVEST.name: Dark Harvest
DARK_HARVEST.desc: Jumps to the cell surrounded by the most enemies, then for 3s the 8 cells around it take 5/10/20 special damage per second; heals 30% of it.

KING_SHIELD.name: King's Shield
KING_SHIELD.desc: Protects itself 1.5s, gains 10/20/40 shield and swaps place with the farthest enemy.

PURSUIT.name: Pursuit
PURSUIT.desc: Deals 35/70/140 special damage to the target and marks it: if it jumps or teleports, jumps next to it and casts again.

FLAMETHROWER.name: Flamethrower
FLAMETHROWER.desc: Breathes fire in the target direction, up to 3 cells: 30/60/120 special damage and burn 4s.

DOUBLE_SHOCK.name: Double Shock
DOUBLE_SHOCK.desc: Paralyses itself 3s to deal 50/100/200 special damage to the target.

RAPID_SPIN.name: Rapid Spin
RAPID_SPIN.desc: Deals 20/50/100 special damage and gains 50% of ATK as DEF and SPE_DEF.

GROWL.name: Growl
GROWL.desc: Enemies on the 8 cells around it flinch 3s and lose 3/5/7 ATK.

AIR_SLASH.name: Air Slash
AIR_SLASH.desc: Makes the target flinch 7s and deals 25/50/100 special damage.

WISH.name: Wish
WISH.desc: The lowest HP% ally gains 30/60/120 shield and is protected 1.5s.

BLAZE_KICK.name: Blaze Kick
BLAZE_KICK.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage (x1.3 if burned), burns 2s and kicks the target back as far as possible.

BITE.name: Bite
BITE.desc: Deals 300/400/500% ATK as special damage, heals 50% of it and makes the target flinch 5s.

DRAGON_TAIL.name: Dragon Tail
DRAGON_TAIL.desc: Deals 30/60/100 special damage and gains 2/4/6 DEF and SPE_DEF.

BULLDOZE.name: Bulldoze
BULLDOZE.desc: Enemies on the 8 cells around it take 25/45/85 special damage, lose 10 SPEED and are pushed back 1 cell.

ICICLE_MISSILE.name: Icicle Missile
ICICLE_MISSILE.desc: After 1s, icicles hit the 1/2/3 front-most enemies: 50 special damage and freeze 2s.

UPROAR.name: Uproar
UPROAR.desc: For 3s, deals 5/10/20 special damage per second to every enemy within its attack range.

SLASH.name: Slash
SLASH.desc: Deals 10/20/40 special damage with +30/60/90% crit chance.

METEOR_MASH.name: Meteor Mash
METEOR_MASH.desc: Hits the target 3 times for 100/120/140% ATK as special damage, gaining 2 ATK per hit.

TROP_KICK.name: Trop Kick
TROP_KICK.desc: Lowers the target ATK by 3/5/7 and deals 50/100/200 special damage.

PETAL_DANCE.name: Petal Dance
PETAL_DANCE.desc: Throws 3/4/5 petals at the closest enemies, 20/30/50 special damage each.

HEADBUTT.name: Headbutt
HEADBUTT.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage (doubled on a shielded target) and makes it flinch 5s.

TWISTER.name: Twister
TWISTER.desc: Enemies on the 8 cells around it take 25/50/100 special damage and are blown away 1/2/3 cells.

SHOCKWAVE.name: Shockwave
SHOCKWAVE.desc: A shockwave on every cell within 2 of it: 30/60/120 special damage, -20% per cell of distance.

TORCH_SONG.name: Torch Song
TORCH_SONG.desc: Blows 4 flames at random enemies: 50% ATK as special damage, 30% chance to burn 2s, +1/2/3 AP per flame.

DRAGON_BREATH.name: Dragon Breath
DRAGON_BREATH.desc: Breathes in the target direction up to range+1 cells: 25/50/100 special damage.

DARKEST_LARIAT.name: Darkest Lariat
DARKEST_LARIAT.desc: Moves behind the target and hits it several times (more with SPEED) for 100% ATK as special damage each.

AQUA_TAIL.name: Aqua Tail
AQUA_TAIL.desc: Deals 30/60/100 special damage and gains 30/60/100 shield.

FUTURE_SIGHT.name: Future Sight
FUTURE_SIGHT.desc: Marks the 3/4/5 closest enemies; 2s later each takes 20/30/50 special damage and 20% of it splashes on the 8 cells around.

ACCELEROCK.name: Accelerock
ACCELEROCK.desc: Dashes next to the farthest enemy and deals 100/125/250% ATK as special damage, trading DEF for SPEED.

ROCK_ARTILLERY.name: Rock Artillery
ROCK_ARTILLERY.desc: Fires 10/15/25 rocks on random cells around enemies, 20/30/40 special damage each.

ICY_WIND.name: Icy Wind
ICY_WIND.desc: A freezing wind in a line through the target to the board edge: 25/50/100 special damage and -10/20/40 SPEED.

GIGATON_HAMMER.name: Gigaton Hammer
GIGATON_HAMMER.desc: Deals 100/200/400 special damage, then is fatigued for 6s.

ENTANGLING_THREAD.name: Entangling Thread
ENTANGLING_THREAD.desc: The target and the 8 cells around it: 10/20/40 special damage and paralysis 4s.

FIRESTARTER.name: Firestarter
FIRESTARTER.desc: Flies away, burning the cells on its path: 20/40/80 special damage, then gains 10/20/40 SPEED.

GLAIVE_RUSH.name: Glaive Rush
GLAIVE_RUSH.desc: Charges to the other end of the board: enemies on its path take 50/100/200 special damage; everyone hit (and itself) loses armor 6s.

NIGHTMARE.name: Nightmare
NIGHTMARE.desc: Every enemy is fatigued (halved PP gain) for 2/4/6s; the ones under a Ghost curse also take 25/50/100 special damage.

DRUM_BEATING.name: Drum Beating
DRUM_BEATING.desc: Cycles between 3 beats: team +10/20/40 SPEED, team +10/20/40 shield, all enemies take 10/20/40 special damage.

SOFT_BOILED.name: Soft-Boiled
SOFT_BOILED.desc: Every ally gains 20/40/80 shield and is cured of negative statuses.

KOWTOW_CLEAVE.name: Kowtow Cleave
KOWTOW_CLEAVE.desc: A guaranteed crit for 150% ATK as true damage, +20% ATK per fallen ally.

TRI_ATTACK.name: Tri Attack
TRI_ATTACK.desc: Freezes 3s, burns 5s or paralyses 7s the target (random), and deals 60/120/250 special damage.

HORN_DRILL.name: Horn Drill
HORN_DRILL.desc: Deals 300/400/500% ATK as special damage, with a 30% chance (higher if its ATK is higher) to one-shot the target.

VOLT_SWITCH.name: Volt Switch
VOLT_SWITCH.desc: Dashes next to the farthest enemy; enemies on its path take 25/50/100 special damage.

SNIPE_SHOT.name: Snipe Shot
SNIPE_SHOT.desc: Shoots the farthest enemy: every enemy on the cells in between takes 40/80/160 special damage.

PSYCHIC.name: Psychic
PSYCHIC.desc: The target and the 8 cells around it: 40/80/160 special damage and -15 PP.

FURY_SWIPES.name: Fury Swipes
FURY_SWIPES.desc: Swipes the target 5 times in 1s for 100% ATK as physical damage each.

COLUMN_CRUSH.name: Column Crush
COLUMN_CRUSH.desc: Builds a pillar (wood/iron/concrete) on the closest free cell. If a pillar of its team is already on the board, jumps on it and throws it at the nearest enemy: 50/100/150 + the HP the pillar had left as special damage.

STEAMROLLER.name: Steamroller
STEAMROLLER.desc: Rolls next to the farthest enemy: enemies on its path take 40/80/150% SPEED as special damage, 50% chance to flinch 3s.

DRAGON_RAGE.name: Dragon Rage
DRAGON_RAGE.desc: Gains 15/30/45 shield. Each second for 6s: +5/10/15 shield and 5/10/15 special damage to the adjacent enemies. Then the shield it gave left turns into a heal of 40% of it.

PSYSTRIKE.name: Psystrike
PSYSTRIKE.desc: A psychic wave toward the farthest enemy: 20/40/80 special damage to the enemies on its path, each teleported to the back of its side.

SKY_ATTACK.name: Sky Attack
SKY_ATTACK.desc: Soars out of reach, lands next to the farthest enemy and strikes it 1s later for 30/60/120 special damage.

FIRE_BLAST.name: Fire Blast
FIRE_BLAST.desc: A star-shaped blast on the target: 30/60/110 special damage to every enemy in it.

THUNDER.name: Thunder
THUNDER.desc: Lightning strikes 3 random enemies, 0.5s apart: 25/50/100 special damage, 30% chance of paralysis 3s.

OVERHEAT.name: Overheat
OVERHEAT.desc: Every enemy within 4 cells of the target takes 12/25/50 special damage (x1.3 if burned).

BLIZZARD.name: Blizzard
BLIZZARD.desc: Every enemy within 4 cells takes 10/20/40 special damage (x1.3 if frozen) and freezes 1.5s.

FLAME_CHARGE.name: Flame Charge
FLAME_CHARGE.desc: Charges next to the farthest enemy: enemies on its path take 30/60/120 special damage.

AQUA_JET.name: Aqua Jet
AQUA_JET.desc: Jets next to the farthest enemy: enemies on its path take 20/40/80 special damage.

ORIGIN_PULSE.name: Origin Pulse
ORIGIN_PULSE.desc: A wave along the target's row: 50/75/100 special damage to every enemy on it.

DRACO_METEOR.name: Draco Meteor
DRACO_METEOR.desc: A meteor falls on the target 1s later: 30/60/120 special damage to it and the adjacent enemies, then it loses 20 AP.

PRECIPICE_BLADES.name: Precipice Blades
PRECIPICE_BLADES.desc: Deals 25/50/100 special damage to every enemy on its row or its column.

THUNDER_CAGE.name: Thunder Cage
THUNDER_CAGE.desc: Cages the target and the 8 cells around it: 15/30/60 special damage, locked and paralysed 3s.

HAIL.name: Hail
HAIL.desc: 8/15/30 hailstones fall on random cells of the target's side: 50 special damage and freeze 1s to an enemy there; the cells keep hail (10 special damage and freeze 1s to whoever steps on them).

CRUSH_GRIP.name: Crush Grip
CRUSH_GRIP.desc: Deals 15/25/50 + up to 50/100/200 special damage, the healthier the target the more.

STEALTH_ROCKS.name: Stealth Rock
STEALTH_ROCKS.desc: Lays stealth rocks on a cone of 1/2/3 cells toward the target; the enemies there take 30/40/50 special damage.

IRON_HEAD.name: Iron Head
IRON_HEAD.desc: Gains 5/10/15 DEF and SPE_DEF, then deals its DEF + SPE_DEF as special damage to the target.

DRAGON_ENERGY.name: Dragon Energy
DRAGON_ENERGY.desc: Deals its current HP as special damage to the target.

ROAR_OF_TIME.name: Roar of Time
ROAR_OF_TIME.desc: The strongest ally without one gets a resurrection and 10/15/20 SPEED.

SHADOW_FORCE.name: Shadow Force
SHADOW_FORCE.desc: Takes its Origin form, teleports into the largest group of enemies and deals 30/45/60 special damage to the adjacent ones, breaking Protect, Reflect and Magic Bounce. Its ability becomes Shadow Claw.

SPACIAL_REND.name: Spacial Rend
SPACIAL_REND.desc: Reverses the positions of the enemy team, then deals 20/60/100 special damage to every enemy on the target's row.

JUDGEMENT.name: Judgement
JUDGEMENT.desc: Deals 10 special damage to the target, multiplied by the sum of its team's synergy levels of its own types.

CRABHAMMER.name: Crabhammer
CRABHAMMER.desc: Deals 40/80/160 special damage with +30% crit chance. A target under 30% HP is knocked out.

STORED_POWER.name: Stored Power
STORED_POWER.desc: Deals 10/15/20 special damage, increased by each of its stat boosts (ATK, DEF, SPE_DEF, SPEED above base, AP above 100).

PSYCHO_CUT.name: Psycho Cut
PSYCHO_CUT.desc: Slashes in a straight line toward the target to the board edge: every enemy on it takes 10/20/40 special damage 3 times.

SILVER_WIND.name: Silver Wind
SILVER_WIND.desc: Gains 1 ATK, DEF and SPE_DEF, 10 SPEED and 10 AP, then dashes next to the farthest enemy: enemies on its path take 20/40/80 special damage.

POISON_POWDER.name: Poison Powder
POISON_POWDER.desc: Dashes next to the farthest enemy: enemies on its path are POISONED 3s and take 20/40/80 special damage.

BLOOD_MOON.name: Blood Moon
BLOOD_MOON.desc: A beam through the target to the board edge: 200% ATK as special damage and WOUND 3s to every enemy on it.

TRANSE.name: Transe
TRANSE.desc: Leaves Zen mode: back to Standard mode, healing 30% of its max HP.

OCTAZOOKA.name: Octazooka
OCTAZOOKA.desc: Deals 300% ATK as special damage to the target and blinds it for 4s.

SCHOOLING.name: Schooling
SCHOOLING.desc: Deals 15% of its max HP as special damage to adjacent enemies. Wishiwashi on your bench join the school: +50 max HP for good each.

RAGE.name: Rage
RAGE.desc: Enrages itself for 3s and gains 10% of its base ATK per 10% of max HP missing.

RETURN.name: Return
RETURN.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage to the target and gains 2 AP permanently.

COUNTER.name: Counter
COUNTER.desc: Deals 50% of its missing HP as special damage to adjacent enemies.

DISABLE.name: Disable
DISABLE.desc: Silences the target and the enemies around it for 2/3/4s and deals 12/25/50 special damage.

BULK_UP.name: Bulk Up
BULK_UP.desc: Gains 50% of its base ATK and base DEF.

CHARGE.name: Charge
CHARGE.desc: Its basic attacks now deal additional special damage equal to its ATK times the number of abilities cast.

PAYDAY.name: Pay Day
PAYDAY.desc: Deals 15/30/60 special damage, doubled with AP. Gains gold equal to its stars if the target is KO.

HYPER_BEAM.name: Hyper Beam
HYPER_BEAM.desc: After charging 1s, fires a beam through the target to the board edge: 65/130/250 special damage. Then fatigued for 5s.

FOCUS_PUNCH.name: Focus Punch
FOCUS_PUNCH.desc: After 0.9s, punches the target out of the board if nothing stands behind it; otherwise deals 500% ATK as special damage and pushes it as far as possible.

SUBSTITUTE.name: Substitute
SUBSTITUTE.desc: Jumps to the closest free cell and leaves a Substitute doll with 25% of its max HP; enemies attacking it switch to the doll.

SKILL_SWAP.name: Skill Swap
SKILL_SWAP.desc: Copies the ability of the target for the rest of the fight and uses it immediately.

SURF.name: Surf
SURF.desc: Surfs to the farthest enemy: enemies on the way take 20/40/80 special damage and are pushed aside.

DRAGON_DARTS.name: Dragon Darts
DRAGON_DARTS.desc: Throws 3 darts at the target, each dealing 10/20/40 special damage. Regains 40 PP if the target is KO.

FAKE_TEARS.name: Fake Tears
FAKE_TEARS.desc: Every enemy suffers ARMOR_BREAK for 3s and takes 5/10/15 special damage.

FOUL_PLAY.name: Foul Play
FOUL_PLAY.desc: Deals 2/4/6 times the ATK of the target as special damage.

HEAT_CRASH.name: Heat Crash
HEAT_CRASH.desc: Crashes into the target: 40/60/80 special damage plus twice its ATK above the ATK of the target, and knocks it back.

OUTRAGE.name: Outrage
OUTRAGE.desc: Gets confused for 2s and deals 300% ATK as special damage to the target and its allies next to the user.

POWDER.name: Powder
POWDER.desc: Blows powder toward the fastest enemy in range: enemies on the way take 10/20/30 special damage and lose 10/20/30 SPEED for 5s.

PYRO_BALL.name: Pyro Ball
PYRO_BALL.desc: Kicks a fireball to the farthest enemy: enemies on the way burn for 2s and take 10/20/40 special damage.

SLUDGE_WAVE.name: Sludge Wave
SLUDGE_WAVE.desc: The target and the enemies around it are POISONED for 2/3/4s and take 10/20/40 special damage.

SPARKLING_ARIA.name: Sparkling Aria
SPARKLING_ARIA.desc: Deals 15/25/50 special damage to the target and enemies around it; cures the burn of allies around it.

SPIRIT_SHACKLE.name: Spirit Shackle
SPIRIT_SHACKLE.desc: Shoots an arrow through the target to the board edge: 25/50/75 special damage and WOUND for 4s.

WATER_SHURIKEN.name: Water Shuriken
WATER_SHURIKEN.desc: Throws 3 shurikens toward the target and 45 degrees aside, to the board edge: 20/40/60 special damage to every enemy hit.

ZAP_CANNON.name: Zap Cannon
ZAP_CANNON.desc: ARMOR_BREAK and PARALYSIS on the target for 1/2/4s, then 25/50/100 special damage.

ACROBATICS.name: Acrobatics
ACROBATICS.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage, then leaps to a free cell in range of the target, farther with fewer items held.

INGRAIN.name: Ingrain
INGRAIN.desc: Allies around it heal 15/30/60 HP; enemies around it are LOCKED for 4s and take 15/30/60 special damage.

SWEET_SCENT.name: Sweet Scent
SWEET_SCENT.desc: Enemies within 3 cells can no longer dodge, lose 4/6/8 SPE_DEF and 10/12/15 SPEED, and have 30% chance to be CHARM for 1s.

STUN_SPORE.name: Stun Spore
STUN_SPORE.desc: The target and the enemies around it are PARALYSIS for 5s and take 15/30/60 special damage.

PETAL_BLIZZARD.name: Petal Blizzard
PETAL_BLIZZARD.desc: Deals 10/20/30 special damage to adjacent enemies and gains 10 AP.

HIDDEN_POWER_A.name: Hidden Power (ABRA)
HIDDEN_POWER_A.desc: Summon 4 Abra, one at each corner of the battlefield.

HIDDEN_POWER_B.name: Hidden Power (BURN)
HIDDEN_POWER_B.desc: BURN all enemy Pokémon for 30 seconds.

HIDDEN_POWER_C.name: Hidden Power (COIN)
HIDDEN_POWER_C.desc: Give AMULET_COIN to all allied Pokémon. The item is removed at the end of the fight.

HIDDEN_POWER_D.name: Hidden Power (DUPE)
HIDDEN_POWER_D.desc: Transform into a copy of your STRONGEST ally without its items and permanent buffs.

HIDDEN_POWER_E.name: Hidden Power (EGGS)
HIDDEN_POWER_E.desc: Add a EGG_FOR_SELL to the allied player's bench. It hatches in the next stage.

HIDDEN_POWER_F.name: Hidden Power (FISH)
HIDDEN_POWER_F.desc: Fish 2 random WATER Pokémon at max fishing level.

HIDDEN_POWER_H.name: Hidden Power (HEAL)
HIDDEN_POWER_H.desc: Heal all allied Pokémon to max HP.

HIDDEN_POWER_I.name: Hidden Power (ITEM)
HIDDEN_POWER_I.desc: The allied player gets a random item component.

HIDDEN_POWER_K.name: Hidden Power (KICK)
HIDDEN_POWER_K.desc: Summon Hitmonlee with a RED_ORB and max PP.

HIDDEN_POWER_L.name: Hidden Power (LOCK)
HIDDEN_POWER_L.desc: All enemy Pokémon are LOCKED for 5 seconds.

HIDDEN_POWER_N.name: Hidden Power (NUKE)
HIDDEN_POWER_N.desc: All allied Pokémon gain [50,SP] SHIELD then explode, dealing [50,SP] SPECIAL to all ADJACENT enemy Pokémon and to themselves.

HIDDEN_POWER_O.name: Hidden Power (OVEN)
HIDDEN_POWER_O.desc: Cook a random dish for all your Pokémon next fight.

HIDDEN_POWER_Q.name: Hidden Power (QUIT)
HIDDEN_POWER_Q.desc: Immediately end the fight with a draw.

HIDDEN_POWER_R.name: Hidden Power (ROLL)
HIDDEN_POWER_R.desc: The allied player gets 6 free shop rerolls.

HIDDEN_POWER_S.name: Hidden Power (SURF)
HIDDEN_POWER_S.desc: BOARD_EFFECT: a TIDAL_WAVE cleans up negative status and field effects, heals 20% HP of all your team and knocks back and damages enemies for 10% of their HP as TRUE.

HIDDEN_POWER_T.name: Hidden Power (TREE)
HIDDEN_POWER_T.desc: The allied player gets 3 random berries.

HIDDEN_POWER_U.name: Hidden Power (UXIE)
HIDDEN_POWER_U.desc: Summon Uxie with AQUA_EGG and max PP.

HIDDEN_POWER_V.name: Hidden Power (VOLT)
HIDDEN_POWER_V.desc: Lightning strikes all enemies, dealing [30,SP] SPECIAL to all enemy Pokémon.

HIDDEN_POWER_W.name: Hidden Power (WISH)
HIDDEN_POWER_W.desc: The allied player gets a high rarity Pokémon matching one of their 2 highest synergies.

HIDDEN_POWER_X.name: Hidden Power (XRAY)
HIDDEN_POWER_X.desc: Gives XRAY_VISION to all allied Pokémon. The item is removed at the end of the fight.

HIDDEN_POWER_Y.name: Hidden Power (YOGA)
HIDDEN_POWER_Y.desc: All your team increase their ATK by [100,SP]% of its BASE value.

HIDDEN_POWER_Z.name: Hidden Power (ZERO)
HIDDEN_POWER_Z.desc: FREEZE all enemy Pokémon for 2 seconds.

HIDDEN_POWER_QM.name: Hidden Power (?)
HIDDEN_POWER_QM.desc: The allied player gets 4 random Unown on their bench.

HIDDEN_POWER_EM.name: Hidden Power (!)
HIDDEN_POWER_EM.desc: Summon 4 random Unown, one at each corner of the battlefield.

HORN_LEECH.name: Horn Leech
HORN_LEECH.desc: Deals 200% ATK as special damage and heals 50% of the damage dealt; half of the overheal becomes SHIELD.

EXPLOSION.name: Explosion
EXPLOSION.desc: Deals 50/100/200 special damage to adjacent enemies and to itself.

LEECH_SEED.name: Leech Seed
LEECH_SEED.desc: Heals 20/40/80 HP and POISON the target for 3/6/12s.

AERIAL_ACE.name: Aerial Ace
AERIAL_ACE.desc: Deals 25/50/100 TRUE damage to the target.

AQUA_RING.name: Aqua Ring
AQUA_RING.desc: Moves to the spot surrounded by the most allies; itself and the allies around are cured and heal 20/40/80 HP.

IRON_DEFENSE.name: Iron Defense
IRON_DEFENSE.desc: Every ally on its row gains 20/40/80 SHIELD.

SLASHING_CLAW.name: Slashing Claw
SLASHING_CLAW.desc: Deals 15/30/60 special damage (x1.3 if the target is wounded) and WOUND for 5s.

WONDER_GUARD.name: Wonder Guard
WONDER_GUARD.desc: Adjacent enemies are PARALYSIS for 3s and take 30/60/120 special damage.

ABSORB.name: Absorb
ABSORB.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage; itself and the allies around heal 10% of it.

ARM_THRUST.name: Arm Thrust
ARM_THRUST.desc: Hits the target 2 to 5 times (more with LUCK), each hit dealing 100% ATK as physical damage with its own crit chance.

AROMATHERAPY.name: Aromatherapy
AROMATHERAPY.desc: Adjacent allies are cured of negative statuses and heal 20/40/80 HP.

ASSURANCE.name: Assurance
ASSURANCE.desc: Deals 25/50/100 special damage, doubled if the user is under 50% HP.

AURASPHERE.name: Aura Sphere
AURASPHERE.desc: Fires a sphere through the target to the board edge: 25/50/100 special damage and SILENCE for 3s.

AURORA_BEAM.name: Aurora Beam
AURORA_BEAM.desc: A beam through the target to the board edge: 25/50/100 special damage, 50% chance to FREEZE for 2s.

AXE_KICK.name: Axe Kick
AXE_KICK.desc: Leaps next to the enemy with the most PP: 25/50/100 special damage, burns 15 PP, 30% chance of CONFUSION for 3s.

BANEFUL_BUNKER.name: Baneful Bunker
BANEFUL_BUNKER.desc: PROTECT for 2s; melee attackers take 10/20/30 special damage and are POISONED for 3s. Taunts adjacent enemies.

BEAT_UP.name: Beat Up
BEAT_UP.desc: Summons 1/2/3 Houndour, their max HP increased by AP.

BODY_SLAM.name: Body Slam
BODY_SLAM.desc: Deals 30% of its max HP as special damage (50% at 3 stars).

BONEMERANG.name: Bonemerang
BONEMERANG.desc: Throws a bone through the target to the board edge that comes back 1s later: 15/30/60 special damage each way.

BONE_ARMOR.name: Bone Armor
BONE_ARMOR.desc: Jumps next to the enemy with the lowest HP%: 20/40/80 special damage, heals the damage dealt; a kill gives 4/8/12 DEF and SPE_DEF.

CITY_SHUTTLE.name: City Shuttle
CITY_SHUTTLE.desc: Carries the closest ally to the farthest enemy: enemies on the way take 10/20/40 special damage plus the ATK of the passenger; both gain 20/40/80 SHIELD.

COIL.name: Coil
COIL.desc: LOCKED and PARALYSIS on the target for 3s; gains 3/5/10 ATK and DEF.

CONFUSION.name: Confusion
CONFUSION.desc: A confused target takes 75/150/300 special damage; otherwise it is SILENCE and CONFUSION for 3/5/7s.

COTTON_SPORE.name: Cotton Spore
COTTON_SPORE.desc: The 3 closest enemies lose 10/20/30 SPEED and a cotton ball is left under each of them (sleep 1s).

CROSS_POISON.name: Cross Poison
CROSS_POISON.desc: The target and the enemies around it take 30/60/120 special damage and are POISONED for 2s.

DETECT.name: Detect
DETECT.desc: Adjacent allies get PROTECT for 0.5/0.6/0.8s per enemy within 2 cells.

DIAMOND_STORM.name: Diamond Storm
DIAMOND_STORM.desc: Deals 100% of its DEF (150% at 3 stars) as special damage to adjacent enemies.

DIG.name: Dig
DIG.desc: Digs to the farthest enemy: enemies on the way take 10/20/40 special damage.

DISARMING_VOICE.name: Disarming Voice
DISARMING_VOICE.desc: Enemies within 1/2/3 cells are CHARM for 1s.

DRILL_RUN.name: Drill Run
DRILL_RUN.desc: Deals 15/30/60 TRUE damage (can crit) and takes the place of the target; an enemy right behind becomes the next target with full PP.

EAR_DIG.name: Ear Dig
EAR_DIG.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage, +5/10/20 per depth of the hole under the target; digs a hole if there is none.

ELECTRIFY.name: Electrify
ELECTRIFY.desc: The strongest non-ELECTRIC ally gets ELECTRIC_FIELD, the ELECTRIC synergy of the team and 15/30/60 SHIELD.

ELECTRO_BALL.name: Electro Ball
ELECTRO_BALL.desc: A ball bouncing from enemy to enemy, 10/20/40 special damage each; faster users bounce more.

ENCORE.name: Encore
ENCORE.desc: Casts again the last ability used by its team.

FAKE_OUT.name: Fake Out
FAKE_OUT.desc: FLINCH for 3s and 40/80/150 special damage; the user loses 30 AP.

FIRE_FANG.name: Fire Fang
FIRE_FANG.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage and BURN for 2s.

HEAD_SMASH.name: Head Smash
HEAD_SMASH.desc: Deals 40/80/150 special damage (a sleeping or frozen target is KO); takes 10/20/40 recoil damage.

CAVERNOUS_CHOMP.name: Cavernous Chomp
CAVERNOUS_CHOMP.desc: Deals 40/80/160 special damage; if the target is KO, the user is enraged for 1/2/3s.

DIVE.name: Dive
DIVE.desc: Gains 15/30/60 SHIELD and dives where the enemies are the most packed: 10/20/40 special damage to adjacent enemies.

DRAIN_PUNCH.name: Drain Punch
DRAIN_PUNCH.desc: Deals 200% ATK as special damage and heals twice the damage dealt.

EGG_BOMB.name: Egg Bomb
EGG_BOMB.desc: The target and its allies around take 25/50/100 special damage and ARMOR_BREAK for 4s; a KO has 25% chance to give an egg.

ELECTRO_WEB.name: Electro Web
ELECTRO_WEB.desc: Adjacent enemies take 15/30/60 special damage and the user steals 15/30/60 of their SPEED.

HEAL_BLOCK.name: Heal Block
HEAL_BLOCK.desc: Adjacent enemies take 20/40/80 special damage and WOUND for 5s.

HYPNOSIS.name: Hypnosis
HYPNOSIS.desc: The farthest enemy falls asleep for 1/1.75/3s, doubled by AP.

ICE_HAMMER.name: Ice Hammer
ICE_HAMMER.desc: FREEZE on the target for 3s and PARALYSIS on itself for 3s, then 50/100/200 special damage.

FEATHER_DANCE.name: Feather Dance
FEATHER_DANCE.desc: Flies to the farthest enemy; 8/10/12 feathers fall on its path: allies gain and enemies lose HP, ATK, DEF, AP, SPE_DEF, SPEED or LUCK.

FIRE_SPIN.name: Fire Spin
FIRE_SPIN.desc: The target and the enemies around it take 25/50/100 special damage and BURN for 3s.

FIRST_IMPRESSION.name: First Impression
FIRST_IMPRESSION.desc: Deals 45/90/180 special damage and FLINCH for 5s. On its first cast, jumps to safety and a Bug Pokémon appears where it stood.

FISSURE.name: Fissure
FISSURE.desc: Opens 2/3/4 rifts on random cells: 25/50/75 special damage to enemies on the cell and around.

FROST_BREATH.name: Frost Breath
FROST_BREATH.desc: Breathes a cone in front of it: 35/70/140 special damage (can crit), 50% chance to FREEZE for 2s.

GUNK_SHOT.name: Gunk Shot
GUNK_SHOT.desc: Deals 50/100/200 special damage and POISON for 2/4/8s.

HELPING_HAND.name: Helping Hand
HELPING_HAND.desc: The 2 closest allies gain 30/60/100 SHIELD and their next ability deals double damage.

HIGH_HORSEPOWER.name: High Horsepower
HIGH_HORSEPOWER.desc: Charges behind the target, then deals 15/30/60 special damage to adjacent enemies (doubled if there is only one).

HYPER_VOICE.name: Hyper Voice
HYPER_VOICE.desc: Every enemy on the row of the target takes 25/50/100 special damage, 30% chance of CONFUSION.

IRON_TAIL.name: Iron Tail
IRON_TAIL.desc: Enemies in front of it take 100% of its DEF as special damage and are knocked back.

JAW_LOCK.name: Jaw Lock
JAW_LOCK.desc: LOCKED for 3s and 125% ATK + 10/15/20 special damage; biting the same target again heals 25/50/100 HP.

LAST_RESPECTS.name: Last Respects
LAST_RESPECTS.desc: Deals 30/60/90 special damage to an adjacent enemy and curses it: KO after 10/8/6s.

LAVA_PLUME.name: Lava Plume
LAVA_PLUME.desc: Enemies in front of it take 20/40/80 special damage; EMBER is left on the cells.

LINGERING_AROMA.name: Lingering Aroma
LINGERING_AROMA.desc: For 5s, melee attackers take 10/20/30 special damage and lose 5 PP.

LOVELY_KISS.name: Lovely Kiss
LOVELY_KISS.desc: A sleeping target takes 50/100/150 special damage; otherwise it falls asleep for 2/4/6s.

MACH_PUNCH.name: Mach Punch
MACH_PUNCH.desc: Deals 25/50/100 special damage and acts again right away.

MAGIC_BOUNCE.name: Magic Bounce
MAGIC_BOUNCE.desc: Reflects the abilities it receives for 4s (special damage bounced back), but is SILENCE meanwhile.

MAGNET_RISE.name: Magnet Rise
MAGNET_RISE.desc: Itself and its 2/4/6 weakest adjacent allies get PROTECT for 2s and 10% dodge chance.

MIMIC.name: Mimic
MIMIC.desc: Uses the ability of its target.

MOON_DREAM.name: Moon Dream
MOON_DREAM.desc: Puts the target to SLEEP for 3/6/9s; the 3 allies closest to it gain 10/20/30 SHIELD.

MORTAL_SPIN.name: Mortal Spin
MORTAL_SPIN.desc: Adjacent enemies targeting it take 20/40/80 special damage, POISON for 4/4/8s and are pushed back.

MOUNTAIN_GALE.name: Mountain Gale
MOUNTAIN_GALE.desc: Throws 1/3/5 icicles at adjacent enemies or the target: 40 special damage and FLINCH for 3s each.

MUD_SHOT.name: Mud Shot
MUD_SHOT.desc: Deals 25/50/100 special damage and lowers SPEED by 10/20/30.

NIGHT_DAZE.name: Night Daze
NIGHT_DAZE.desc: Deals 25/50/100 special damage and BLINDED for 3s.

NIGHT_SHADE.name: Night Shade
NIGHT_SHADE.desc: Deals 25/33/50% of the target max HP as true damage (more with AP).

OCTOLOCK.name: Octolock
OCTOLOCK.desc: Deals 30/60/90 special damage, LOCKED and ARMOR_BREAK for 3/3/6s.

PARABOLIC_CHARGE.name: Parabolic Charge
PARABOLIC_CHARGE.desc: Heals 25/50/75 HP, then deals 25/50/100 special damage plus the overheal.

POISON_GAS.name: Poison Gas
POISON_GAS.desc: Fills the cells around with POISON_GAS: enemies take 15/30/60 special damage and POISON for 3s.

POISON_JAB.name: Poison Jab
POISON_JAB.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage, POISON for 3s on the target and on itself, and trades places with the target.

POISON_STING.name: Poison Sting
POISON_STING.desc: Adds 2/3/4 POISON stacks; each stack over the limit deals 25/50/100 special damage.

POLTERGEIST.name: Poltergeist
POLTERGEIST.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage, +20 per item held by the target (+40 per tool).

POWDER_SNOW.name: Powder Snow
POWDER_SNOW.desc: Enemies in a line take 20/40/80 special damage, 15/30/50% chance to FREEZE for 2s.

POWER_HUG.name: Power Hug
POWER_HUG.desc: LOCKED and PARALYSIS for 3/3/6s, then 40/80/160 special damage.

PSYBEAM.name: Psybeam
PSYBEAM.desc: Enemies in a line take 25/50/100 special damage, 50% chance of CONFUSION for 2/3/4s.

PSYSHOCK.name: Psyshock
PSYSHOCK.desc: Burns 20/40/80 PP of the target and gains as much SHIELD; missing PP is dealt as special damage.

RAZOR_WIND.name: Razor Wind
RAZOR_WIND.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage; can critically hit.

ROAR.name: Roar
ROAR.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage and blows the target to the far end of the line, hitting the enemies on the way.

ROCK_HEAD.name: Rock Head
ROCK_HEAD.desc: Deals 120/120/150% of its ATK + DEF as special damage.

ROCK_SMASH.name: Rock Smash
ROCK_SMASH.desc: Deals 25/50/100 special damage and ARMOR_BREAK for 3/6/9s.

ROCK_TOMB.name: Rock Tomb
ROCK_TOMB.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage and lowers SPEED by 10/20/40.

ROCK_WRECKER.name: Rock Wrecker
ROCK_WRECKER.desc: FLINCH for 2s and 80/160/320 special damage, then FATIGUE on itself for 4s.

ROLLOUT.name: Rollout
ROLLOUT.desc: Gains 2/5/10 DEF, then deals 200% of its DEF as special damage.

SAND_SPIT.name: Sand Spit
SAND_SPIT.desc: Enemies in front of it take 30/60/120 special damage and BLINDED for 2s.

SAND_TOMB.name: Sand Tomb
SAND_TOMB.desc: PARALYSIS and SILENCE for 3/5/8s, and 10/20/40 special damage.

SHADOW_CLONE.name: Shadow Clone
SHADOW_CLONE.desc: A copy of itself appears with 50/50/90% of its max HP, holding an item stolen from the target.

SHADOW_PUNCH.name: Shadow Punch
SHADOW_PUNCH.desc: Teleports next to the enemy with the lowest HP %; its next attack deals 30/60/120 more special damage.

SHELL_SMASH.name: Shell Smash
SHELL_SMASH.desc: Adjacent enemies take 15/30/60 special damage; gains 20 AP, 2 ATK and 20 SPEED but loses 2 DEF and 2 SPE_DEF.

SHORE_UP.name: Shore Up
SHORE_UP.desc: Heals 20/25/40% of its max HP (+10% in SANDSTORM).

SILK_TRAP.name: Silk Trap
SILK_TRAP.desc: PROTECT for 1.5s; melee attackers meanwhile lose 5/10/15 SPEED and get PARALYSIS for 1.5s.

SLUDGE.name: Sludge
SLUDGE.desc: Enemies in front of it get 2/3/4 POISON stacks for 3s.

SMOG.name: Smog
SMOG.desc: Leaves SMOKE in front of it; enemies there take 10/20/40 special damage.

SOLAR_BEAM.name: Solar Beam
SOLAR_BEAM.desc: Enemies in a line take 25/50/100 special damage and BURN for 3s; stronger in ZENITH or on the light cell.

SOLAR_BLADE.name: Solar Blade
SOLAR_BLADE.desc: Charges for 2s (instant on the light cell), then enemies in front of it take 30/60/120 true damage.

SPARK.name: Spark
SPARK.desc: Deals 30/60/90 special damage, then bounces to adjacent enemies, halving the damage each time.

SPICY_EXTRACT.name: Spicy Extract
SPICY_EXTRACT.desc: Its 1/2/3 closest allies get RAGE for 2s.

SPIKES.name: Spikes
SPIKES.desc: Scatters 6 SPIKES in front of it; enemies there take 25/50/100 special damage.

SPITE.name: Spite
SPITE.desc: Drains 20/40/60 PP from the target and shares it among its adjacent allies.

STICKY_WEB.name: Sticky Web
STICKY_WEB.desc: Deals 20/35/70 special damage and leaves STICKY_WEB in front of it (PARALYSIS).

STONE_EDGE.name: Stone Edge
STONE_EDGE.desc: For 5/8/10s: SILENCE on itself, +20% crit chance and +2 range.

STUFF_CHEEKS.name: Stuff Cheeks
STUFF_CHEEKS.desc: Eats a held berry (its heals become SHIELD); otherwise forages a random berry.

SUPERCELL_SLAM.name: Supercell Slam
SUPERCELL_SLAM.desc: Gains 10/20/40 SHIELD and rushes where enemies are the most packed: 10/20/40 special damage around.

SUPER_FANG.name: Super Fang
SUPER_FANG.desc: Deals 20/30/50% of the target max HP as true damage (more with AP).

SWAGGER.name: Swagger
SWAGGER.desc: CONFUSION and RAGE for 1.5/2/3s on the target.

SWALLOW.name: Swallow
SWALLOW.desc: Stockpiles (+3 DEF and SPE_DEF); under 25% HP swallows to heal; at 3 stacks spits up 40/80/150 special damage.

TEA_TIME.name: Tea Time
TEA_TIME.desc: Every ally heals 15/30/60 HP and eats its berry.

THIEF.name: Thief
THIEF.desc: Steals the items of the target, then deals 15/30/60 special damage.

THRASH.name: Thrash
THRASH.desc: Gains 100/100/120% of its base ATK but gets CONFUSION for 3s.

TOPSY_TURVY.name: Topsy-Turvy
TOPSY_TURVY.desc: Deals 40/80/160 special damage and turns the target's ATK, AP, DEF and SPE_DEF changes upside down.

TOXIC.name: Toxic
TOXIC.desc: Its 1/2/3 closest enemies are POISONED for 3/6/9s.

TRICK_OR_TREAT.name: Trick-or-Treat
TRICK_OR_TREAT.desc: Steals an item of the target; if it has none, turns it into a Magikarp for 3/3/10s.

TRIPLE_DIVE.name: Triple Dive
TRIPLE_DIVE.desc: Dives at the 3 enemies with the lowest HP: 15/30/60 special damage each.

TWINEEDLE.name: Twineedle
TWINEEDLE.desc: Deals 25/50/80 special damage twice; the second hit has 50% chance to POISON for 4s.

TWIN_BEAM.name: Twin Beam
TWIN_BEAM.desc: Two beams toward the farthest enemies: 30/60/100 special damage in each line.

VINE_WHIP.name: Vine Whip
VINE_WHIP.desc: PARALYSIS for 3s on the target and its neighbours, 30/60/100 special damage to the target.

VISE_GRIP.name: Vise Grip
VISE_GRIP.desc: LOCKED for 4s on both, 30/60/100 special damage; gains the DEF and SPE_DEF of the target for 4s.

WATERFALL.name: Waterfall
WATERFALL.desc: Gains 50/100/150 SHIELD and cleanses its negative statuses and the effects of its cell.

WATER_PULSE.name: Water Pulse
WATER_PULSE.desc: The target and the enemies around it take 70/140/280 special damage, 30% chance of CONFUSION for 2s.

WHIRLWIND.name: Whirlwind
WHIRLWIND.desc: Blows the target away, then deals 40/80/120 special damage.

WONDER_ROOM.name: Wonder Room
WONDER_ROOM.desc: For 5s, the enemies around the target swap DEF and SPE_DEF and take attacks as special damage.

WOOD_HAMMER.name: Wood Hammer
WOOD_HAMMER.desc: Deals 400/400/800% of its ATK as special damage, then takes its ATK as recoil.

WISE_YAWN.name: Wise Yawn
WISE_YAWN.desc: The ally with the lowest HP gains 15/30/60 SHIELD; the enemies targeting it get FATIGUE for 3s and lose 20 AP.

YAWN.name: Yawn
YAWN.desc: The enemies targeting it get FATIGUE for 3s and lose 20 AP; gains 15/30/60 SHIELD.

AFTER_YOU.name: After You
AFTER_YOU.desc: The strongest closest ally gains 5/10/15 PP and 5/10/15 SPEED.

ANCHOR_SHOT.name: Anchor Shot
ANCHOR_SHOT.desc: Drags the farthest enemy next to it and deals 20/40/80 special damage.

APPLE_ACID.name: Apple Acid
APPLE_ACID.desc: Enemies in front of it take 15/30/50 special damage, doubled if their SPE_DEF is 0.

ARMOR_CANNON.name: Armor Cannon
ARMOR_CANNON.desc: Deals 15/30/50 special damage to the target, bouncing to the 2 closest enemies and back.

AURA_WHEEL.name: Aura Wheel
AURA_WHEEL.desc: Switches mode, gains 10 SPEED and deals 20/40/60 special damage; acts again quickly.

BARED_FANGS.name: Bared Fangs
BARED_FANGS.desc: Deals 120/140/160% of its ATK as special damage and steals 10 SPEED.

BIDE.name: Bide
BIDE.desc: Stores the damage received for 3s (no PP gain), then adjacent enemies take 100/150/200% of it as special damage.

BITTER_BLADE.name: Bitter Blade
BITTER_BLADE.desc: Adjacent enemies take 50/60/70 special damage; heals 10% max HP per enemy hit.

BOLT_BEAK.name: Bolt Beak
BOLT_BEAK.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage, doubled if the target has more than 40 PP.

BOOMBURST.name: Boomburst
BOOMBURST.desc: Every adjacent unit, allies included, takes 60 special damage and FLINCH for 4s.

BOUNCE.name: Bounce
BOUNCE.desc: Bounces 1/2/3 times next to the farthest enemy: adjacent enemies take 15/20/25 special damage.

CAMOUFLAGE.name: Camouflage
CAMOUFLAGE.desc: Heals 30/50/70 HP and takes the look, range and best ATK / DEF / SPE_DEF of the target.

CHARM.name: Charm
CHARM.desc: The target loses 2/3/4 ATK and is CHARMED for 3s.

CHATTER.name: Chatter
CHATTER.desc: Enemies within 3 cells take 10/20/30 special damage, 50% chance of CONFUSION for 1s.

CLOSE_COMBAT.name: Close Combat
CLOSE_COMBAT.desc: Loses 2 DEF and SPE_DEF, deals 30/65/130 special damage.

COSMIC_POWER_SUN.name: Cosmic Power (Sun)
COSMIC_POWER_SUN.desc: Every other ally gains 25% of its base ATK.

COTTON_GUARD.name: Cotton Guard
COTTON_GUARD.desc: Gains 15/30/60 SHIELD and 3 DEF; cotton in front of it puts enemies to SLEEP for 1s.

DECORATE.name: Decorate
DECORATE.desc: The strongest closest ally gains 1/2/3 ATK, 10/20/30 AP and the bonus of the Alcremie flavor.

DEEP_FREEZE.name: Deep Freeze
DEEP_FREEZE.desc: Fires 5/7/9 ice bolts: 10 special damage and -1 SPE_DEF each, chaining to the next enemy on a KO.

DIZZY_PUNCH.name: Dizzy Punch
DIZZY_PUNCH.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage (doubled on a shielded target) and CONFUSION for 3s.

DRAGON_PULSE.name: Dragon Pulse
DRAGON_PULSE.desc: Deals 10/15/20 special damage to the target, spreading twice to the enemies around; +5 AP per hit.

ECHO.name: Echo
ECHO.desc: Enemies around take 3/6/9 special damage per cast so far; the range grows with each cast.

ELECTRO_SHOT.name: Electro Shot
ELECTRO_SHOT.desc: Charges for 2s (instant in STORM), gains 40 AP and deals 80/100/120 special damage in a line.

ENTRAINMENT.name: Entrainment
ENTRAINMENT.desc: Gains 10 PP; the target's ability becomes Entrainment.

FACADE.name: Facade
FACADE.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage, doubled when it has a negative status.

FAIRY_LOCK.name: Fairy Lock
FAIRY_LOCK.desc: LOCKED for 5s; 50/70/90 special damage shared among the target and the enemies around.

FELL_STINGER.name: Fell Stinger
FELL_STINGER.desc: Deals 400% of its base ATK as special damage; a KO gives +30% base ATK.

FICKLE_BEAM.name: Fickle Beam
FICKLE_BEAM.desc: Flips 5 coins: one beam per head at the fastest enemies, PARALYSIS for 2s and 20/30/40 special damage.

FILLET_AWAY.name: Fillet Away
FILLET_AWAY.desc: Loses 30% max HP, gains 5/8/10 ATK and 10/15/20 SPEED, PROTECT for 1s and hides in a corner.

FISHIOUS_REND.name: Fishious Rend
FISHIOUS_REND.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage, doubled if it is faster than the target.

FLING.name: Fling
FLING.desc: Throws its Ball: enemies on the way take 30% of its SPEED as special damage. Without a Ball, jumps to a corner and gets one.

FLORAL_HEALING.name: Floral Healing
FLORAL_HEALING.desc: Heals as much HP as its max PP.

FLYING_PRESS.name: Flying Press
FLYING_PRESS.desc: Skydives next to the farthest enemy and deals 50% of its max HP as special damage.

FOLLOW_ME.name: Follow Me
FOLLOW_ME.desc: Jumps away and gains 10/20/40 SHIELD; the enemies that targeted it are CHARMED for 1/2/3s.

FORCE_PALM.name: Force Palm
FORCE_PALM.desc: Deals 15/30/60 + 10% of the target max HP as special damage and PARALYSIS; a paralysed target is blown away instead.

FORECAST.name: Forecast
FORECAST.desc: Every ally gains 10 SHIELD plus the Castform form bonus (Sun ATK, Rain PP, Hail DEF / SPE_DEF).

FREEZE_DRY.name: Freeze-Dry
FREEZE_DRY.desc: Deals 30/50/70 + its SPE_DEF as special damage; on a KO, the enemies around take a part of it.

GOLD_RUSH.name: Gold Rush
GOLD_RUSH.desc: Deals 20 special damage + 1 per gold of the player, and earns 2 gold.

GRAV_APPLE.name: Grav Apple
GRAV_APPLE.desc: Deals 20/40/80 physical damage, doubled if the target has no DEF.

GROWTH.name: Growth
GROWTH.desc: Gains 3/5/7 ATK and 10/20/40 max HP (doubled in ZENITH).

GRUDGE_DIVE.name: Grudge Dive
GRUDGE_DIVE.desc: Deals 30/60/90 special damage + 5/10/15 per fallen ally; takes 10% max HP as recoil.

GULP_MISSILE.name: Gulp Missile
GULP_MISSILE.desc: Shoots an Arrokuda (sometimes a Pikachu) next to the target, dealing 25/40/55 special damage.

HEADLONG_RUSH.name: Headlong Rush
HEADLONG_RUSH.desc: Rushes to the farthest enemy, pushing aside the enemies on the way: 20/40/80 special damage to it, 10/20/30 to the others.

HYPERSPACE_FURY.name: Hyperspace Fury
HYPERSPACE_FURY.desc: Hits 1/2/3 times: -1 DEF and SPE_DEF and 15 special damage each.

HYPER_DRILL.name: Hyper Drill
HYPER_DRILL.desc: Deals 10/20/40 true damage through PROTECT and digs a hole under the target.

ICE_FANG.name: Ice Fang
ICE_FANG.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage and FREEZE for 1/1.5/2s.

INFESTATION.name: Infestation
INFESTATION.desc: Deals 10 special damage per Bug ally; on its first cast, the strongest Bug of the bench joins the fight.

JET_PUNCH.name: Jet Punch
JET_PUNCH.desc: Deals 100% of its SPEED as special damage.

KNOCK_OFF.name: Knock Off
KNOCK_OFF.desc: Deals 30/60/90 special damage + 15/20/30 per item of the target, which loses them for this fight.

KNOWLEDGE_THIEF.name: Knowledge Thief
KNOWLEDGE_THIEF.desc: Uses the ability of its target; the player gains 1 XP.

LINK_CABLE.name: Link Cable
LINK_CABLE.desc: Rushes to the farthest enemy, then links with its partner: 40 special damage to the enemies on the link and around both.

LUSTER_PURGE.name: Luster Purge
LUSTER_PURGE.desc: A ball goes and comes back through the line: 10/20/30 special damage and -5 SPE_DEF each time.

MAKE_IT_RAIN.name: Make It Rain
MAKE_IT_RAIN.desc: Deals 25/50/100 special damage + 1 per gold of the player.

MAWASHI_GERI.name: Mawashi Geri
MAWASHI_GERI.desc: Deals 20/40/60 special damage (doubled if its ATK is higher) and kicks the target far away.

MEGA_PUNCH.name: Mega Punch
MEGA_PUNCH.desc: Deals 20/40/60 special damage, doubled if its DEF is higher.

MIST_BALL.name: Mist Ball
MIST_BALL.desc: A ball goes and comes back through the line: 10/20/30 special damage and -30 AP each time.

MOONBLAST.name: Moonblast
MOONBLAST.desc: Sends 6 moons: 10/14/18 special damage each; a KO sends the rest to the next enemy with a bonus moon.

NASTY_PLOT.name: Nasty Plot
NASTY_PLOT.desc: Gains 4/7/10 ATK and acts again quickly.

NIGHT_SLASH.name: Night Slash
NIGHT_SLASH.desc: Deals 15/30/60 special damage; can critically hit.

NO_RETREAT.name: No Retreat
NO_RETREAT.desc: Per Falinks trooper in formation: +1 ATK, DEF, SPE_DEF, +5 SPEED and a 20 special damage tackle.

NUTRIENTS.name: Nutrients
NUTRIENTS.desc: The ally with the lowest HP heals 20/30/40 HP and gains 1/2/3 DEF and SPE_DEF.

ORDER_UP.name: Order Up
ORDER_UP.desc: Deals 30/60/100 special damage; with a Tatsugiri, it and the Rice eaters get bonuses, else a Tatsugiri comes to the bench.

PLASMA_FIST.name: Plasma Fist
PLASMA_FIST.desc: Deals 60/90/120 special damage and heals 30% of it.

PLASMA_FLASH.name: Plasma Flash
PLASMA_FLASH.desc: Flashes 4 + casts times: 5/10/20 special damage each.

PLASMA_TEMPEST.name: Plasma Tempest
PLASMA_TEMPEST.desc: Flies away, then 3 beams through its closest enemies: 20/30/40 special damage.

POWER_WASH.name: Power Wash
POWER_WASH.desc: Water sweeps the row with the most enemy HP: 80/120/160 special damage shared among its enemies.

POWER_WHIP.name: Power Whip
POWER_WHIP.desc: Deals 15/30/60 + 30% of its HP as special damage.

PRESENT.name: Present
PRESENT.desc: A random gift: 20/40/80, 50/100/150 or 100/200/300 special damage... or it heals the target 50 HP.

PSYCHIC_FANGS.name: Psychic Fangs
PSYCHIC_FANGS.desc: The target's ATK, DEF and SPE_DEF fall back to base; deals 20/40/80 special damage.

PSYCHO_SHIFT.name: Psycho Shift
PSYCHO_SHIFT.desc: The farthest enemy trades places with the target; both take 20/40/60 special damage.

PSYSHIELD_BASH.name: Psyshield Bash
PSYSHIELD_BASH.desc: Charges to the farthest enemy with PROTECT for 1s: enemies on the way take 30/40/50 special damage.

PUMMELING_PAYBACK.name: Pummeling Payback
PUMMELING_PAYBACK.desc: Deals 20/40/60 + 125% of its ATK as special damage and heals 20/30/40 HP.

PURIFY.name: Purify
PURIFY.desc: Cleanses itself and the adjacent allies, heals 15/30/60 HP.

RAGING_BULL.name: Raging Bull
RAGING_BULL.desc: Breaks PROTECT, REFLECT and MAGIC_BOUNCE, ARMOR_BREAK for 3s and 20/40/80 special damage.

SHADOW_SNEAK.name: Shadow Sneak
SHADOW_SNEAK.desc: Deals 25/40/50 special damage, true damage on a silenced target.

SHED_TAIL.name: Shed Tail
SHED_TAIL.desc: The ally with the lowest HP gains 40/60/80 SHIELD; it joins it and leaves a Substitute behind.

SHELL_TRAP.name: Shell Trap
SHELL_TRAP.desc: With a shield: bursts it, enemies around take 50 + the shield as special damage. Otherwise gains 25/50/75 SHIELD.

SHIELDS_DOWN.name: Shields Down
SHIELDS_DOWN.desc: Drops its shell: turns into a Minior core and gets Shields Up.

SHIELDS_UP.name: Shields Up
SHIELDS_UP.desc: Puts its shell back on: turns into Minior and gets Shields Down.

SKETCH.name: Sketch
SKETCH.desc: Does nothing by itself: Smeargle sketches abilities with its passive.

SKITTER_SMACK.name: Skitter Smack
SKITTER_SMACK.desc: Skitters behind the target: 15/30/60 special damage and -20 AP.

SMOKE_SCREEN.name: Smoke Screen
SMOKE_SCREEN.desc: Jumps where enemies are packed: 10/20/40 special damage around, and SMOKE on their row.

SNORE.name: Snore
SNORE.desc: Enemies in front of it get FLINCH for 3s and take 20/40/60 special damage.

SONG_OF_DESIRE.name: Song of Desire
SONG_OF_DESIRE.desc: The 1/1/2 backmost enemies are CHARMED for 3s and lose 3 ATK.

SOUL_TRAP.name: Soul Trap
SOUL_TRAP.desc: Gains 25/50/108 SHIELD; enemies within 2 cells lose 10 PP and get FATIGUE for 2s.

STATIC_SHOCK.name: Static Shock
STATIC_SHOCK.desc: Deals 30/50/70 special damage; heals per adjacent Fairy and gains SHIELD per adjacent Electric.

STOCKPILE.name: Stockpile
STOCKPILE.desc: Gains 30/40/50 max HP but loses 10 SPEED; every 4th cast spits up 50% of its max HP as special damage.

STRUGGLE_BUG.name: Struggle Bug
STRUGGLE_BUG.desc: Adjacent enemies lose 30 AP and take 10/20/30 special damage.

SUPER_HEAT.name: Super Heat
SUPER_HEAT.desc: 9 bursts of heat in a cone: 4/7/10 special damage and ARMOR_BREAK for 1s each.

SYRUP_BOMB.name: Syrup Bomb
SYRUP_BOMB.desc: The fastest enemy loses 30 SPEED and takes 30/40/50 special damage.

TAIL_GLOW.name: Tail Glow
TAIL_GLOW.desc: Gains 30 AP; adjacent enemies take 10/20/30 special damage.

TEETER_DANCE.name: Teeter Dance
TEETER_DANCE.desc: Gains 20 SPEED; every Pokémon on the board gets CONFUSION for 3s.

TRIMMING_MOWER.name: Trimming Mower
TRIMMING_MOWER.desc: Dashes where the most enemies are, heals 30/45/60 HP (overheal as SHIELD), then 20/30/40 special damage around.

TRIPLE_KICK.name: Triple Kick
TRIPLE_KICK.desc: Up to 3 adjacent enemies take 20/40/60 special damage.

UNBOUND.name: Unbound
UNBOUND.desc: Hoopa unleashes its true form: +1 star, +10 ATK, +100 max HP and Hyperspace Fury.

VENOSHOCK.name: Venoshock
VENOSHOCK.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage, doubled when it is poisoned itself.

VESPIQUEN_ORDERS.name: Vespiquen's Orders
VESPIQUEN_ORDERS.desc: Vespiquen gives orders to the Combee with its passive.

VOLT_SURGE.name: Volt Surge
VOLT_SURGE.desc: Gains 10/20/30 max HP, 20 SPEED and ELECTRIC_FIELD; then every 3rd attack bounces lightning through 4 enemies.

ZING_ZAP.name: Zing Zap
ZING_ZAP.desc: Deals 30/60/90 special damage and FLINCH for 3s, then bounces behind the target.

BUG_BITE.name: Bug Bite
BUG_BITE.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage and steals and eats the berry of the target.

MAGNET_PULL.name: Magnet Pull
MAGNET_PULL.desc: Attracts a random Steel Pokémon that can be caught by clicking it.

SWARM.name: Swarm
SWARM.desc: A Bug of the team hatches from the Bug Nest, one stronger per cast.

TAKE_HEART.name: Take Heart
TAKE_HEART.desc: Gains 4/6/8 ATK and SPE_DEF, cleanses itself and acts again quickly.

THUNDERCLAP_PRESS.name: Thunderclap Press
THUNDERCLAP_PRESS.desc: Pushes the target to the far end of the line: it and the enemies on the way get PARALYSIS for 4s and take 20/40/80 special damage.

TRANSFORM.name: Transform
TRANSFORM.desc: Becomes a copy of the target: stars, ability, passive and stats.

ACID_SPRAY.name: Acid Spray
ACID_SPRAY.desc: 5 sprays chaining through adjacent enemies: -5 SPE_DEF and 11/22/33 special damage each.

ASTRAL_BARRAGE.name: Astral Barrage
ASTRAL_BARRAGE.desc: Jumps to a back corner and sends 3/5/7 ghosts at random enemies: 20 special damage each.

BEHEMOTH_BLADE.name: Behemoth Blade
BEHEMOTH_BLADE.desc: Deals 30/60/90 + its ATK as special damage, then jumps behind the target.

BLEAKWIND_STORM.name: Bleakwind Storm
BLEAKWIND_STORM.desc: Enemies in a line take 45/60/75 special damage and FREEZE for 2s.

BLUE_FLARE.name: Blue Flare
BLUE_FLARE.desc: The target and the enemies around take 12/25/50 special damage + 10 per Fire Pokémon of the team.

BURNING_JEALOUSY.name: Burning Jealousy
BURNING_JEALOUSY.desc: The target and the enemies around take 30/50/70 special damage; those with ATK buffs lose them and BURN for 5s.

CHAIN_CRAZED.name: Chain Crazed
CHAIN_CRAZED.desc: Poisons itself, gains 10/15/20 SPEED, 5/10/15 ATK and 3/6/10 DEF.

CHARGE_BEAM.name: Charge Beam
CHARGE_BEAM.desc: A beam chains through 3 enemies: 15/30/60 special damage each.

CORE_ENFORCER.name: Core Enforcer
CORE_ENFORCER.desc: A Z-shaped blast around the target: SILENCE for 3s and 20/40/60 special damage.

CRUNCH.name: Crunch
CRUNCH.desc: Deals 40/80/160 special damage; a KO heals 50% of the target max HP.

DARK_VOID.name: Dark Void
DARK_VOID.desc: Enemies within 4 cells of the target take 10/20/30 special damage, 80% chance to SLEEP for 2s.

DOOM_DESIRE.name: Doom Desire
DOOM_DESIRE.desc: 2s later, the target takes 100/125/150 special damage.

DOUBLE_IRON_BASH.name: Double Iron Bash
DOUBLE_IRON_BASH.desc: Hits twice for 150% of its ATK as physical damage, FLINCH for 3s.

DYNAMAX_CANNON.name: Dynamax Cannon
DYNAMAX_CANNON.desc: Enemies in a line take 30/40/50% of their max HP as special damage.

EXTREME_SPEED.name: Extreme Speed
EXTREME_SPEED.desc: Dashes to the farthest enemy: enemies on the way take 20/30/40 special damage.

FLEUR_CANNON.name: Fleur Cannon
FLEUR_CANNON.desc: Enemies in a line take 50/75/100 special damage; loses 20 AP.

FUSION_BOLT.name: Fusion Bolt
FUSION_BOLT.desc: The target and the enemies around take 30/40/50 special damage + 10 per Electric Pokémon of the team.

GLACIAL_LANCE.name: Glacial Lance
GLACIAL_LANCE.desc: Goes to a back corner and throws a lance: 300% of its ATK as special damage, half to the enemies around.

GLACIATE.name: Glaciate
GLACIATE.desc: The target and the enemies around take 30/40/50 special damage + 10 per Ice Pokémon of the team.

HEART_SWAP.name: Heart Swap
HEART_SWAP.desc: Deals 60/80/100 special damage, steals the target's SPE_DEF buffs and AP and gives it its own negative statuses.

LANDS_WRATH.name: Land's Wrath
LANDS_WRATH.desc: The target and the enemies around take 20/30/40 + its ATK as special damage and lose 5 DEF and SPE_DEF.

LASER_BLADE.name: Laser Blade
LASER_BLADE.desc: Alternates a spin behind the target (SHIELD, 25 special damage around) and a double slash (25 + ATK special damage).

LOCK_ON.name: Lock-On
LOCK_ON.desc: Its next attack cannot be dodged and deals 200% extra as true damage.

LUNAR_BLESSING.name: Lunar Blessing
LUNAR_BLESSING.desc: Every wounded ally heals 25% of its max HP and is cleansed.

LUNGE.name: Lunge
LUNGE.desc: Jumps at the enemy with the most ATK: -3/4/5 ATK and 30/40/50 special damage.

MAGMA_STORM.name: Magma Storm
MAGMA_STORM.desc: A fire storm hops from enemy to adjacent enemy: 50/75/100 special damage, 20% weaker at each hop.

MALIGNANT_CHAIN.name: Malignant Chain
MALIGNANT_CHAIN.desc: The target is POSSESSED (fights for your team) and gets 3 POISON stacks for 3s.

MIND_BEND.name: Mind Bend
MIND_BEND.desc: The target is POSSESSED for 2s; a protected or possessed target takes 100 special damage instead.

MIND_BLOWN.name: Mind Blown
MIND_BLOWN.desc: Loses 50% max HP; 3/4/5 fireworks burst over the enemies with random effects (burn, fatigue, true damage, or shields for allies).

MOONGEIST_BEAM.name: Moongeist Beam
MOONGEIST_BEAM.desc: On the line: enemies get PARALYSIS for 3s and 60/80/100 special damage, allies gain as much SHIELD.

MULTI_ATTACK.name: Multi-Attack
MULTI_ATTACK.desc: Adjacent enemies take 7/10/13 special damage per synergy level of its types.

OBLIVION_WING.name: Oblivion Wing
OBLIVION_WING.desc: Deals 90/120/150 special damage and heals 75% of it.

PRISMATIC_LASER.name: Prismatic Laser
PRISMATIC_LASER.desc: A 3-column laser sweeps the board: 30/40/50 special damage, enemies pushed back.

PSYCHO_BOOST.name: Psycho Boost
PSYCHO_BOOST.desc: The target and its row neighbours take 90/120/150 special damage; loses 10 AP per hit.

RELIC_SONG.name: Relic Song
RELIC_SONG.desc: Every ally gains 10 SHIELD; every 3rd cast, every enemy falls asleep instead.

SACRED_SWORD_CAVERN.name: Sacred Sword (Cavern)
SACRED_SWORD_CAVERN.desc: Deals 40/60/80 true damage + 20 per enemy on its side of the board.

SACRED_SWORD_GRASS.name: Sacred Sword (Grass)
SACRED_SWORD_GRASS.desc: Deals 40/60/80 true damage + 10 per ally still standing.

SACRED_SWORD_IRON.name: Sacred Sword (Iron)
SACRED_SWORD_IRON.desc: Deals 40/60/80 true damage + 15 per fallen ally.

SANDSEAR_STORM.name: Sandsear Storm
SANDSEAR_STORM.desc: Enemies in a line take 45/60/75 special damage and BURN for 2s.

SCALE_SHOT.name: Scale Shot
SCALE_SHOT.desc: 8 scales gather around it (40 special damage to adjacent enemies), then fly at the farthest enemy.

SEARING_SHOT.name: Searing Shot
SEARING_SHOT.desc: Enemies within 2 cells take 30/40/50 special damage and BURN for 3s.

SECRET_SWORD.name: Secret Sword
SECRET_SWORD.desc: Deals 50/100/150 special damage, true damage once it has blocked 20 hits.

SEED_FLARE.name: Seed Flare
SEED_FLARE.desc: Enemies within 5 cells lose 3 SPE_DEF and take 20/25/30 special damage.

SHADOW_CLAW.name: Shadow Claw
SHADOW_CLAW.desc: Enemies in front of it take 20/40/60 special damage (60/100/140 when alone); heals 25% of it.

SPECTRAL_THIEF.name: Spectral Thief
SPECTRAL_THIEF.desc: Deals 30/40/50 special damage, rushes away and steals every stat buff of the target.

SPRINGTIDE_STORM.name: Springtide Storm
SPRINGTIDE_STORM.desc: Enemies in a line take 45/60/75 special damage and are CHARMED for 2s.

STEAM_ERUPTION.name: Steam Eruption
STEAM_ERUPTION.desc: The target and the enemies around take 20/40/80 special damage and BURN for 3s.

SUNSTEEL_STRIKE.name: Sunsteel Strike
SUNSTEEL_STRIKE.desc: Skydives where enemies are packed: 40/60/80 special damage around.

SURGING_STRIKES.name: Surging Strikes
SURGING_STRIKES.desc: Strikes 3 times for 100% of its ATK as special damage, always critical.

THOUSAND_ARROWS.name: Thousand Arrows
THOUSAND_ARROWS.desc: 33 arrows rain on random cells: enemies hit are LOCKED for 1s and take 40/50/60 special damage.

TIME_TRAVEL.name: Time Travel
TIME_TRAVEL.desc: Every ally heals 25 HP and is cleansed; Celebi also gives you 1 life.

ULTRA_THRUSTERS.name: Ultra Thrusters
ULTRA_THRUSTERS.desc: Adjacent enemies take 20/40/80 special damage and BURN for 2s, then it blasts off to a back corner.

U_TURN.name: U-turn
U_TURN.desc: Trades places with the target, gains 15/30/50 SHIELD and CHARMS the target for 1s.

WILDBOLT_STORM.name: Wildbolt Storm
WILDBOLT_STORM.desc: Enemies in a line get PARALYSIS for 4s and take 45/60/75 special damage.

BRAVE_BIRD.name: Brave Bird
BRAVE_BIRD.desc: Flies away to a safe spot, pulls the target next to it and deals 30/60/90 special damage.

DISCHARGE.name: Discharge
DISCHARGE.desc: Adjacent enemies get PARALYSIS for 5s and take 25/50/100 special damage.

EXPANDING_FORCE.name: Expanding Force
EXPANDING_FORCE.desc: Gains PSYCHIC_FIELD, or gives it to the closest ally without it. Every ally in a PSYCHIC_FIELD deals 10/20/40 special damage to adjacent enemies.

HURRICANE.name: Hurricane
HURRICANE.desc: Enemies in a line get PARALYSIS for 3s and take 25/50/100 special damage.

MUD_BUBBLE.name: Mud Bubble
MUD_BUBBLE.desc: Heals 10/20/40 HP and acts again sooner.

RAZOR_LEAF.name: Razor Leaf
RAZOR_LEAF.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage to enemies in the direction of the target. Can crit.

ROOST.name: Roost
ROOST.desc: Flies away to a safe spot, SLEEP for 1s and gains 20/40/80 SHIELD.

SHELTER.name: Shelter
SHELTER.desc: Gains 3/6/12 DEF and creates SMOKE on the target's cell.

TAIL_WHIP.name: Tail Whip
TAIL_WHIP.desc: The target loses 20/30/40% of its DEF.

TORMENT.name: Torment
TORMENT.desc: Gains 20/35/50 SPEED and acts again sooner.

BITTER_MALICE.name: Bitter Malice
BITTER_MALICE.desc: Deals 25/50/100 special damage and FATIGUE for 3s to the target. While disguised, also hits the enemies ADJACENT to the target, breaking the disguise.

BURN_UP.name: Burn Up
BURN_UP.desc: Deals 50/100/200 special damage to the target, then BURN itself for 3s.

CHLOROBLAST.name: Chloroblast
CHLOROBLAST.desc: Deals 50/100/200 special damage to ADJACENT enemies, and loses 50% of its max HP as true damage.

CRUSH_CLAW.name: Crush Claw
CRUSH_CLAW.desc: The target loses 5/10/15 DEF, then takes 2 hits of 100/100/200% ATK as physical damage.

DOUBLE_EDGE.name: Double-Edge
DOUBLE_EDGE.desc: Deals 55/110/220 physical damage to the target and takes 20/40/60 physical damage.

DRAGON_CLAW.name: Dragon Claw
DRAGON_CLAW.desc: The ADJACENT enemy with the lowest max HP takes 30/60/120 special damage and WOUND for 4s.

EERIE_SPELL.name: Eerie Spell
EERIE_SPELL.desc: A spell bounces 4 times toward the lowest HP units: allies heal 15/30/45 HP, enemies take 10/20/40 special damage.

ICE_SPINNER.name: Ice Spinner
ICE_SPINNER.desc: Spins around, clearing board effects: ADJACENT enemies take 15/30/60 special damage and are knocked back.

INFERNAL_PARADE.name: Infernal Parade
INFERNAL_PARADE.desc: Enemies between it and the farthest enemy take 30 special damage twice, with 50% chance of BURN for 3s.

METRONOME.name: Metronome
METRONOME.desc: Casts the ability of a random Pokémon. Rarer abilities with LUCK.

SHELL_SIDE_ARM.name: Shell Side Arm
SHELL_SIDE_ARM.desc: A shell bounces 4 times toward the highest HP units: allies gain 10/20/30 AP, enemies get POISON for 2/3/4s.

SPIN_OUT.name: Spin Out
SPIN_OUT.desc: Deals 25/50/100% of its SPEED as special damage and BLINDED for 1s to the target, then drives back to its backline, losing its Acceleration stacks.

SPIRIT_BREAK.name: Spirit Break
SPIRIT_BREAK.desc: Deals 20/40/80 special damage to the target, which loses 20 AP.

STRANGE_STEAM.name: Strange Steam
STRANGE_STEAM.desc: Spreads a strange steam around itself, wider each cast: enemies get CONFUSION for 3s (30/30/100% chance), allies get a FAIRY_FIELD. Abilities deal 20% more damage in the steam.

SUCTION_HEAL.name: Suction Heal
SUCTION_HEAL.desc: Deals 15/30/60 special damage to enemies up to 2 cells in front, healing 50% of the damage dealt.

AURORA_VEIL.name: Aurora Veil
AURORA_VEIL.desc: Every ally gains 5/10/20 SHIELD and RUNE_PROTECT for 1s.

GRUDGE.name: Grudge
GRUDGE.desc: The target gets SILENCE for 3s, then every silenced enemy takes 18/36/52 special damage.

HIGH_JUMP_KICK.name: High Jump Kick
HIGH_JUMP_KICK.desc: Steals up to 40 PP from the target and deals 15/30/60 special damage.

METAL_CLAW.name: Metal Claw
METAL_CLAW.desc: Deals 10/20/40 true damage to the target and gains 2/4/6 ATK.

OBSTRUCT.name: Obstruct
OBSTRUCT.desc: PROTECT for 0.5/0.75/1s x (2 + AP/100). Meanwhile its attackers lose 2 DEF.

OVERDRIVE.name: Overdrive
OVERDRIVE.desc: Enemies within 3 cells of the target take 120/120/150% ATK as special damage, 20% less per cell away.

PICKUP.name: Pickup
PICKUP.desc: Takes the first item of the target, then deals 30/60/120 special damage.

POLLEN_PUFF.name: Pollen Puff
POLLEN_PUFF.desc: The ally with the lowest HP heals 30/60/120 HP.

QUIVER_DANCE.name: Quiver Dance
QUIVER_DANCE.desc: Gains 3/4/5 ATK and SPE_DEF, 10 SPEED and 20 AP.

STEEL_WING.name: Steel Wing
STEEL_WING.desc: Flies next to the farthest enemy. Enemies on the way take 10/20/40 + 200% DEF as special damage and give it 1 DEF each.

ANCIENT_POWER.name: Ancient Power
ANCIENT_POWER.desc: Deals 40/80/120 special damage to the target and gains 25 AP.

CEASELESS_EDGE.name: Ceaseless Edge
CEASELESS_EDGE.desc: Creates SPIKES on the cells in front of it; enemies there take 20/40/80 special damage. Can crit.

CLANGOROUS_SOUL.name: Clangorous Soul
CLANGOROUS_SOUL.desc: Itself and ADJACENT allies gain 2/4/8 ATK, DEF and SPE_DEF.

CURSE.name: Curse
CURSE.desc: A random enemy among the ones with the highest max HP gets CURSE: KO after 8/5/3s, less with AP.

DIRE_CLAW.name: Dire Claw
DIRE_CLAW.desc: The target gets POISON, SLEEP or PARALYSIS for 3s and takes 15/30/60 special damage.

DREAM_EATER.name: Dream Eater
DREAM_EATER.desc: Moves next to a sleeping enemy, deals 45/90/150 special damage and heals for the damage dealt. If no enemy sleeps, SLEEP for 3/4/5s to the target and PP refilled.

DRILL_PECK.name: Drill Peck
DRILL_PECK.desc: Deals 30/60/120 special damage and trades places with the target. If an enemy is right behind, it becomes the next target and PP is refilled.

ERUPTION.name: Eruption
ERUPTION.desc: 20/30/45 rocks fall on random cells: enemies hit take 30/50/70 special damage and BURN for 5s.

FIERY_DANCE.name: Fiery Dance
FIERY_DANCE.desc: Gains 30 AP, then deals 25/50/100 special damage to the target.

MUDDY_WATER.name: Muddy Water
MUDDY_WATER.desc: Enemies in front take 40/80/160 special damage, ARMOR_REDUCTION and WOUND for 4s.

NATURAL_GIFT.name: Natural Gift
NATURAL_GIFT.desc: The ally with the lowest HP heals 30/60/90 HP and gets RUNE_PROTECT for 1/2/3s.

PASTEL_VEIL.name: Pastel Veil
PASTEL_VEIL.desc: Dashes next to the farthest ally: allies on the way are cleansed and gain 20/40/80 SHIELD.

SHADOW_BONE.name: Shadow Bone
SHADOW_BONE.desc: Enemies in a line take 30/60/120 special damage, 50% chance to lose 6 DEF.

SHEER_COLD.name: Sheer Cold
SHEER_COLD.desc: Deals 50/100/200 special damage to the target, with 10/20/30% chance (more with more HP than the target) to KO it. Always KO a FREEZE target, never an ICE one.

SLACK_OFF.name: Slack Off
SLACK_OFF.desc: Removes its negative statuses, heals 30% of its max HP, then SLEEP for 3s.

FIERY_WRATH.name: Fiery Wrath
FIERY_WRATH.desc: Enemies within 4 cells take 30/40/50 special damage, with 50% chance of FLINCH for 4s.

FREEZING_GLARE.name: Freezing Glare
FREEZING_GLARE.desc: Enemies in a line take 20/40/80 special damage, with 50% chance of FREEZE for 3s.

HYDRO_STEAM.name: Hydro Steam
HYDRO_STEAM.desc: Blasts steam in front of it: enemies hit take 30/60/100 special damage and BURN for 4s.

IVY_CUDGEL.name: Ivy Cudgel
IVY_CUDGEL.desc: Deals 50/75/100 special damage to the target, with a bonus by mask. Teal: +6 ATK per ADJACENT enemy. Wellspring: ADJACENT allies gain 25 PP and heal 50 HP. Hearthflame: ADJACENT enemies take 30 special damage and BURN for 5s. Cornerstone: ADJACENT enemies FLINCH for 5s and PROTECT for 1s x (2 + AP/100).

SKY_ATTACK_SHADOW.name: Shadow Sky Attack
SKY_ATTACK_SHADOW.desc: Soars out of reach, lands next to the farthest enemy and strikes it 1s later for 30/60/120 special damage. Can crit.

THUNDEROUS_KICK.name: Thunderous Kick
THUNDEROUS_KICK.desc: Kicks the target back as far as possible, pushing aside the enemies on the way. Every enemy hit gets FLINCH for 4s, loses 10 DEF and takes 20/40/60 physical damage.

BARB_BARRAGE.name: Barb Barrage
BARB_BARRAGE.desc: Jumps where the enemies are the most packed; the target and its ADJACENT allies get POISON for 3s and take 15/30/45 special damage.

BULLET_PUNCH.name: Bullet Punch
BULLET_PUNCH.desc: Deals 20/30/40 true damage to the target, gains 20/30/40 SPEED for 2s and acts again sooner.

MISTY_SURGE.name: Misty Surge
MISTY_SURGE.desc: Other FAIRY allies gain 25 PP and heal 25 HP.

PLASMA_FISSION.name: Plasma Fission
PLASMA_FISSION.desc: A beam hits the first enemy toward the target for 20/40/60 special damage, then splits in two perpendicular beams: enemies hit take the damage, halved after each one.

REVELATION_DANCE.name: Revelation Dance
REVELATION_DANCE.desc: Feathers fly on ADJACENT cells: enemies take 15/30/50 special damage, allies gain a bonus by style: Baile 3/6/10 SPEED, Pom-Pom 2/4/6 ATK, Pa'u 2/4/6 SPE_DEF, Sensu 15/30/50 SHIELD.

STONE_AXE.name: Stone Axe
STONE_AXE.desc: Deals 30/40/50 true damage to the target and scatters STEALTH_ROCKS around it.

ATTACK_ORDER.name: Attack Order
ATTACK_ORDER.desc: A Combee joins the fight and every Combee ally is enraged 3s. Its next attack deals 20/40/60 more special damage, +10/20/30 per Combee ally.

HEAL_ORDER.name: Heal Order
HEAL_ORDER.desc: A Combee joins the fight, then it and every Combee heal their adjacent allies 10/20/30 HP and clear their negative statuses.

DEFEND_ORDER.name: Defend Order
DEFEND_ORDER.desc: A Combee joins the fight, every Combee gets 10/20/30 shield and it gets as much plus as much again per Combee ally.
